title: Certificate renewal automation
description: Monitors certificate expiration in Key Vault and triggers renewal workflows before expiry causes outages.
example_prompt: "Check all certificates in Key Vault accounts across subscriptions. For each: show subject, issuer, expiration date, auto-renewal status, and days remaining. For certificates expiring in < 30 days without auto-renewal: trigger renewal workflow or alert the certificate owner. Show certificates that failed auto-renewal attempts."
